# Kimball's Biology Pages

> A comprehensive online biology textbook and reference providing alphabetical access to molecular biology, genetics, cell biology, and biochemistry terminology.

Kimball's Biology Pages is an established educational resource offering detailed definitions and explanations of biological concepts. The site features an alphabetically organized glossary covering molecular biology, genetics, immunology, and cellular biology, making it ideal for students and educators seeking quick reference material.

## Key Topics

- Molecular Biology
- Genetics
- Cell Biology
- Biochemistry
- Immunology
- DNA
- lac operon
- ABC transporter
- Drosophila
- ABO blood groups
- Alphabetical Index
- Biology Glossary
- Online Textbook
- Reference Index
- Biology Terms

## Home & Overview

- [Kimball's Biology Pages](https://biology-pages.info): Homepage for Kimball's Biology Pages online textbook and reference

## Alphabetical Reference Index

- [A - ABC model, Transporters, Blood Groups](https://biology-pages.info/A/A.html): Alphabetical index section A: ABC model, transporters, blood groups
- [B - Immunology & Proteins](https://biology-pages.info/B/B.html): Alphabetical index section B: B7 proteins, CD80, CD86 immunology terms
- [C - Biochemistry & Plant Biology](https://biology-pages.info/C/C.html): Alphabetical index section C: Cadherins, C4/CAM plants, biochemistry
- [D - Molecular Biology & Model Organisms](https://biology-pages.info/D/D.html): Alphabetical index section D: Dalton, zebrafish, molecular biology terms
- [E - Organisms & Cell Biology](https://biology-pages.info/E/E.html): Alphabetical index section E: E. coli, Echinoderms, organism definitions
- [F - Molecular & Cellular Processes](https://biology-pages.info/F/F.html): Alphabetical index section F: Fab fragment, facilitated diffusion terms
- [G - Genetics & Neurobiology](https://biology-pages.info/G/G.html): Alphabetical index section G: GABA receptors, Gamete, genetics terms
- [H - Immunology & Medicine](https://biology-pages.info/H/H.html): Alphabetical index section H: HAART, AIDS, Ham's medium definitions
- [I - Cell Adhesion & Molecular Biology](https://biology-pages.info/I/I.html): Alphabetical index section I: ICAM-1, IAA, immunology and molecular terms
- [K - Biochemistry & Genetics](https://biology-pages.info/K/K.html): Alphabetical index section K: Kallikrein, Karyotype, biochemistry terms
- [L - Gene Regulation & Enzymes](https://biology-pages.info/L/L.html): Alphabetical index section L: lac operon, Lactase, molecular biology terms
- [M - Antibiotics, Proteins & Nucleic Acids](https://biology-pages.info/M/M.html): Alphabetical index section M: Macrolide antibiotics, proteins, nucleic acids
- [N - Immunology & Zoology](https://biology-pages.info/N/N.html): Alphabetical index section N: NK cells, Nematoda, biochemistry terms
- [O - Nucleic Acids & Gene Expression](https://biology-pages.info/O/O.html): Alphabetical index section O: DNA, RNA, operons, molecular biology terms
- [P - Cell Biology & Evolution](https://biology-pages.info/P/P.html): Alphabetical index section P: p16INK4a, Pancreas, Paleozoic era terms
- [Q - Quantitative Genetics & Protein Structure](https://biology-pages.info/Q/Q.html): Alphabetical index section Q: QTL, Quaternary structure, biology terms
- [R - Cell Signaling & Genetics](https://biology-pages.info/R/R.html): Alphabetical index section R: RAF, RAS, RB, cell signaling and genetics
